book.name: LUKASI
book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Pilato
Mbole lumati lwoha lwa bhandu lukiyima na kunnyegha Yesu kwa Pilato.

Nabho bhakiyanda kunkokela paakilongela, “Tukimmona mundu ayu kanguapotongana bhandu bha nnima ghwetu, kanguakanikiha bhandu akotoke kunpegha sumu Mutwa nkulu ghwa Akaaloma na kangulikema mwene ndo Kilisito, Mutwa.”
Ndo Pilato kakinkonya Yesu, “Ghwenga ndo mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi?” Yesu kakinmyanga, “Gwenga ghulongela.”
Ndo Pilato kakiaghombela andundame akulu na lumati lwa bhandu, “Nighubhona ng'obhe uhokelo ghwohele ghula kwa mundu ayu!”
Peni bhene bhakikamala kulongela, “Kanguakolekeha bhandu kwa mahundo ghake mu nnima ghwoha ghwa Yudea. Kakiyanda ako Galilaya na hinu kahika aku.”
Yesu kanguyeghwa kwa Helode
Pilato pakayihwite agha kakikonya, “Mundu ayu nkolannima ghwa ku Galilaya?”
Pakamanyite kukita Yesu kakihuma kunnima ghuubheghite mumakakala gha mutwa Helode, kakinyegha kwa Helode, ywene mumanjubha agho kakibhegha akwo ku Yelusalemu.
Helode kakiyelelwa muno pakammonite Yesu, kiyaha kwa manjubha matangalo kakiyihwa mihalo miyoloho yakya Yesu kakidumbila kummona. Kangi kakipala kummona pakitenda naho.
Helode kakinkonya Yesu makonyo matangalo, peni Yesu kakinnyanga ng'obhe kyohele.
Akaandundame akulu na ahunda bha malaghilo bhakihika kuulongolo, bhakinkokela Yesu kwa ukalipo munu.
Helode na amachonda bhake bhakinkinila Yesu na kunbhikila ubhichi. Bhakinhwaliha lipinda lya kibhutwa na bhakinbhuyila kwa Pilato.
Kalongohi, Helode na Pilato bhakibha amyanja, peni kutandila linjubha alyo akibhegha aghanja.
Yesu kangutoswa kiho
Hinu Pilato kakiakema akaandundame akulu, na hilongohi bha Akaayahudi na bhandu bhangi,

kakiaghombela, “Mwenga mungunnyegha mundu ayu kwa nenga pamunlongela kukita kanguakolekeha bhandu bhaghukiluke utabhala. Hinu nnyihwe! Mbole ya kuhingukiha nhalo agho paulongolo ghwenu nikighubhona ng'obhe uhokelo mungokelo yenu kwa mwene.
Ebhu Helode kakimmona ng'obhe na uhokelo ghwohele ndo mana kakimmuyila kwa nenga. Kulyaghila mundu ayu katenda ng'obhe kyohele kya kuntenda kahweghe.
Hinu ningukwilikiha katutwe hindomondo na ndanlekekeha.”
Mu kila kikubhukubhu kya Pakasa yikibha hitohe ya Palato kubhahughulila bhandu nbhopwa yumu.
Ndo bhandu bhoha bhakituta kyobho kwa papamu, “Ghunkome mundu aywo! Ghutuhughulile Balaba!”
Balaba kakibhopwa mu kibhopo kiyaha kakilongoha bhulwa ngulu mu kitami na kya kukoma.
Pilato kakipala kunlekekeha Yesu, ndo kakilongela nabho kangi.
Peni bhene bhakiyendelela kututa kyobho pakilongela, “Ghunmangalile mulupingika! Ghunbhambe mulupingika!”
Kya pa ndatu Pilato kakiaghombela, “Katenda uhekelo ghani? Nenga ningughubhona ng'obhe uhokelo ghwohele kwa ywombe lya kuntenda kakomwe, hinu nda nntuta hindomondo mbole ndanlekekeha.”
Peni bhene bhakiyendelela kututa kyobho kwa makakala muno, kukita yingunnogha kakamangalilwe. Mu uhiko malobhe ghabhe ghakikingamwa.
Hinu Pilato kakilamula kukita kila bhaakipala bhandu kitendeke.

Kakimmopolela yula mundu bhaanpalite, ywakabheghite mu kibhopo, ywene ywakatendite bhulwa ngulu kwa utabhala na kukoma bhandu. Na kakinkamuha Yesu mu mabhoko ghabhe, ngati bhantendele handa mwaapalite.
Yesu kangubhangalilwa kulupingika

Amachonda pa abheghite mu kunnyegha ku Goligota, bhakikongana na mundu yumu ankemite Simoni ghwa Kulene, ywakabheghite mu kubhuya kuhuma panji ya kitami. Hinu bhakinkamula na bhakinpapiha lula lupingika kaluyeghe kuhyetu kwa Yesu.
Lumati lukulu lwa bhandu lukimmutukila, pakibhegha adala bhaabheghite mu kunlilila na kunhyononekela.
Yesu kakiaghalambukila, na kakiaghombela, “Mwenga makaadala ghwa Yelusalemu, nkotoke kunilila nenga ngati mulilile mabhene na bhana bhenu
Kiyaha kulyaghila manjubha ghatahika apo bhatalongela, ‘Bhanonelwa bhala adala bhangalela, ebu mabhele ghangayongeha.’
Kiyaha mu manjubha agho bhandu bhatayanda kuhighombela hitumbi, ‘Mutughweghele!’ Na hitumbi hichoko hichoko, ‘Mutugubike’
Kiyaha handa bhandu bhaghutendelaa bhabhu nkongo nmihi, kwa njilo yabhegha bhuli?”
Machonda bhakintola Yesu papamu na ahakata abhili, ngati bhakabhambwe mulupingika.

Paahikite pala apakemite Lihuhu lya Mutwe, apa ndo bhakinmangalila Yesu mulupingika, na bhala ahakata abhili bhakiabhamba kila yumo mulupingika lwake yumo mu mbande hyaki ya nnilo ya Yesu na yumo mumbande hyaki ya kungiya.
Yesu kakilongela, “Tate ghubhalekekehe kiyaha bhangumanya ng'obhe kila kyabhaatenda!” Mbole bhakigabhana mapinda ghake kwa kutenda simbi.
Bhandu bhakiyima apwo pa akinlolekeha, na hilongohi ghwa Akaayahudi bhakinbhicha Yesu pa akilongela. “Kakialopoha bhangi! Hinu kalilopohe mwene, handa mwene ndo Kilisito ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga!”
Amachonda nabho bhakihika, na bhakintendela ubhichi na kunkinila, bhakinyeghela kilobhi ili kakanyweghe.
Nabho bhakinng'ombela, “Handa ghwenga ndo Mutwa ghwa Akaayahudi, ghulilopohe ghumwene.”
Hilahila unani mwa lupingika lwake bhakilubhika lupapi luutyekitwe malembo agha, “AYU NDO MUTWA GHWA AKAAYAHUDI.”
Yumoo ghwa bhala ahokelo bhaamangalilitwe papamu naywo kakintendela ufyangu pakalongele, “Ghwenga ndo Kilisito ng'obhe? Ghulilopohe ghumwene na ghutulopohe na twenga.”
Yula nhokelo yungi kakinlakalila nnyake, pakilongela, “Ghwenga, bhuli ghungunnyoghopa ng'obhe Chapanga na ghubhegha mutoso ahyo ahyo?
Twenga tutoswa kwa shaliya kiyaha tungunoghwa toso ya ndendelo yetu. Peni mundu ayu kakitenda ng'obhe kyohele kihakata.”
Mbole kakilongela, “Bambo Yesu, ghuhwachile nenga paghuyingila mu Ubhutwa ghwako.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Kulyaghila, nungughughombela hoto, lelo ghwabhegha papamu na nenga ku Paladiso.”
Yesu kanguhwegha mulipingika
Yikibhegha handa saa sita, kukibhegha na lubhindu mu nnima ghwoha mbaka saa tisa, kiyaha luchubha lukileka kubhuha bhwelo.
Na lipasia liighabhanite pabhili Kitutubhi kya Chapanga likibaluka hipalamande hibhili.
Yesu kakilila kwa lilobhe likulu, “Tate, mu mabhoko ghako ningughubhika nhuki ghwangu.” Mbole ya kughalongela agha kakihwegha.
Yula machonda kilongohi pakabhonite agha, kakintika Chapanga pakilongela, “Kulyaghila mundu ayu kakighatughilagha ghala ghakaghapala Chapanga!”
Bhandu bhoha bhaaghendite kwakya nhalo agho, paabhonote agho ghaabwitukilite bhakibhuya ukaya kwabhe kunu bhaakilituta tuta mu hifubha hyabhe kubhoneha kukita bhakibhegha na hyononeko munu.
Peni aghanja, alongo na bhoha bhaanmanyite Yesu, papamu na bhala adala bhantughilite kuhuma ku Galilaya, bhakiyima kya kutali paakilolekea nnando aghwo.
Yesu kangubhikwa mu lindogholo
Hinu, kukibha na mundu yumu ywa maha lihina lyake likibha Yosefu, ywakabheghite nkolannima ghwa Kualimataya akwo Yudea, kakibhegha mundu ywakaghatughila ghghapalite Chapanga na ywa kuhokamilwa.

Alimatayu kakibhegha mukughulimbilila Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga. Mwene kakibhegha yumoo ywa bhandu bha munjengakaya ya Akaayahudi, peni mwene kakililunga nabho ng'ohe mutoso na ndendelo ya alongohi ayake, naywo kakibhegha mukughulindila Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga kwa upalo nkulu.
Yosefu kakighenda kwa Pilato kuyupa kakakamuhwe mmili ghwa Yesu.
Kakighuhuluha kuhuma kulupingika, kakighubhulungilila sanda na kughubhika mulindogholo lihongolitwe mulitalabha, mualyo lindogholo kakibhikwa ng'obhe mundu ywohele.
Linjubha alyo, likibhegha linjubha lya utendekeho, na Linjubha la Kupumulila, likibhegha ugheghela kuyanda.
Bhala adala bhaahikite papamu na Yesu kuhuma ku Galilaya, bhakintughila Yosefu, bhakilibhona lila lindogholo na bhuli bhuli Yosefu kakighughonjeha mmili ghwa Yesu.
Mbole bhakibhuya ukaya na bhakitendekeha luhumba lwa kunungila na mahuta ghaanungila gha kughutyeka mmili ghwake. Peni bhakipumulila Linjubha lya Kupumulila handa muyibheghite malaghilo gha Musa.
